title: Kuidas ma saan jaama?
topic: Liina is in Tallinn for the first time, asks the way to the station and catches a bus to her train in time

sentences.sk: Liina on pärit Tartust ja ta ei tunne Tallinna.
sentences.en: Liina is from Tartu and does not know Tallinn.

sentences.sk: Nüüd seisab ta pargis ja vaatab kaarti.
sentences.en: Now she is standing in a park and looking at a map.

sentences.sk: Tema rong läheb tunni aja pärast.
sentences.en: Her train leaves in an hour.

sentences.sk: Aga kus on jaam? Kaardil ta seda ei näe.
sentences.en: But where is the station? She can't see it on the map.

sentences.sk: Vabandage, kuidas ma saan jaama?
sentences.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

sentences.sk: Balti jaama? See on kaugel.
sentences.en: The Baltic Station? That's far.

sentences.sk: Kas ma saan jalgsi minna?
sentences.en: Can I walk?

sentences.sk: Saate küll, aga jalgsi on see pool tundi.
sentences.en: You can, but on foot it's half an hour.

sentences.sk: See võtab liiga kaua aega. Minu rong läheb tunni aja pärast.
sentences.en: That takes too long. My train leaves in an hour.

sentences.sk: Siis minge bussiga. Peatus on lähedal.
sentences.en: Then take the bus. The stop is close.

sentences.sk: Ja kus peatus on?
sentences.en: And where is the stop?

sentences.sk: Minge otse ja siis paremale. Peatus on kiriku juures.
sentences.en: Go straight on and then right. The stop is by the church.

sentences.sk: Sealt läheb buss otse jaama.
sentences.en: From there a bus goes straight to the station.

sentences.sk: Aitäh! Ja kust ma pileti ostan?
sentences.en: Thank you! And where do I buy a ticket?

sentences.sk: Pileti saate osta bussis.
sentences.en: You can buy a ticket on the bus.

sentences.sk: Liina läheb otse ja siis paremale.
sentences.en: Liina goes straight on and then right.

sentences.sk: Kiriku juures on peatus, aga bussi seal ei ole.
sentences.en: By the church there is the stop, but there's no bus there.

sentences.sk: Peatuses ootab väike poiss.
sentences.en: A little boy is waiting at the stop.

sentences.sk: Tere! Millal buss jaama läheb?
sentences.en: Hi! When does the bus go to the station?

sentences.sk: Kohe. Vaata, seal ta tuleb!
sentences.en: Right now. Look, there it comes!

sentences.sk: Liina läheb kiiresti bussi ja ostab pileti.
sentences.en: Liina quickly gets on the bus and buys a ticket.

sentences.sk: Buss sõidab üle silla ja siis läbi linna.
sentences.en: The bus goes over the bridge and then through the town.

sentences.sk: Kahekümne minuti pärast on Liina jaamas.
sentences.en: Twenty minutes later Liina is at the station.

sentences.sk: Tema rong on juba seal.
sentences.en: Her train is already there.

sentences.sk: Liina tuleb bussist välja ja naerab.
sentences.en: Liina gets off the bus and laughs.

sentences.sk: Väga hea! Mul on veel aega kohvi juua.
sentences.en: Great! I still have time for a coffee.

questions.q: Miks Liina jalgsi jaama ei lähe?

recap: Liina cannot find the station on her map. A man tells her it is far and sends her to the bus stop by the church, and she reaches her train with time left for a coffee.

pärit.gloss: from (on pärit Tartust: is from Tartu)

aja.gloss: time (tunni aja pärast: in an hour)

balti.gloss: Baltic (Balti jaam: the main station in Tallinn)

võtab.gloss: to take (aega võtma: to take time)
